notes.title: Achievements: Corrected the description of acquisition conditions.
notes.notes:
The conditions for obtaining the achievement “Everyone's Idol” were incorrectly described.
　　
Everyone's Idol: Played the game 50 times.

Everybody's Idol: Played the game 100 times.
　　
This has been corrected.
We apologize for any inconvenience caused by the mistake in the settings.
There will be no updates due to this correction.

notes.title: Start of delivery!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776724/5e9377fcb9b8c3d2a0cde95537e75d7ac119856d.png[/img]

Idol experience in VR☆!
A new action casual VR game, "Fun Pop Rhythm Stage - Aim for the♡", is available on steam today!

This is a new action casual VR game that allows players to enjoy two parts in one game: the "shooting part" in which they shoot out fans that appear one after another in the music, and the "dancing part" in which they trace the notes that appear in the space.

In this version, a "Play with your favorite song" mode has been added, which allows you to load your favorite song and play!
By loading the music data, the score is automatically generated, so you can enjoy the game as many times as you have the music data in your hand.

You don't have to have the music data!
The two theme songs of this work that were popular in the trial version are included, so you can experience idolism right after you buy the game☆!

Please try playing this title, which has been powered up from the trial version!
